name: Martyrs
overview: Scripture reveals that those who suffer persecution and even death for righteousness and the testimony of Jesus are deeply honored in God's kingdom, as they are promised the kingdom of heaven and a place reigning with Christ (Matthew 5:10; Revelation 20:4). Believers are encouraged not to fear physical death but to reverence God who holds authority over both body and soul (Matthew 10:28). The world’s hatred toward Christ’s followers is a reflection of its rejection of Christ Himself (John 15:18), yet believers can stand firm in the assurance that if God is for them, no opposition can ultimately prevail (Romans 8:31). The faithful martyrs are depicted as having their souls under the altar, symbolizing their sacrificial witness and God's recognition of their faithfulness (Revelation 6:9).
